attBesluta.text: Does the job, but some parts are very poorly made and break if over-tightened, especially the cross members. Not very strong, so I reinforced it with wood so it could be better picked up and moved. That said, what did I expect for such a low price?..

we got this to use as a chicken tractor for our meat chickens. Very pleased with it. It was easy to put together and sturdy. We did use hardware cloth instead of the chicken wire that came with it. Over all it is worth the money.

Le poulailler est facile à monter et la structure légère. Le grillage semble résistant, à voir dans le temps. Les tiges livrées pour fixer le poulailler au sol sont beaucoup trop courtes, il faudrait qu'elles mesurent au moins 30 cm.
The assembly of the frame was very easy. Installation of the mesh was a bit more tricky especially joining centre sections. For the money it is good value in my opinion.
La qualité du tapis est bonne, il s'étalle bien sans trop garder de plis, vagues marqué. Parcontre le ruban adhésif double face annoncé n'a pas été livré
